formula_description: Requested finance charge amount under the conditional-if-booked economics basis.
Requested total repayment multiplied by the governed processor-payment cost rate.
Requested funding multiplied by the supported or governed-default partner acquisition cost rate.
Path-weighted EAD multiplied by annual funding cost and expected payoff fraction.
Daily servicing cost over expected payoff horizon plus governed variable servicing cost.
Governed fixed operating cost plus requested-funding variable operating cost.
Processor, partner, funding, servicing, and operating costs summed.
Gross finance revenue less total non-loss costs.
Accepted M1.13 schedule-adjusted comparative expected-loss foundation.
Contribution before comparative loss less accepted comparative loss burden.
Path-weighted EAD multiplied by governed capital allocation, cost of capital, and payoff fraction.
Contribution after comparative loss less synthetic risk-capital charge.
Requested funding multiplied by governed annual hurdle and payoff fraction.
